study: Capsule Review | prespecified Galar-25 training-pool model transfer and streamed source acquisition
protocol_lock_time: before acquiring examination-25 image pixels and before scoring any examination-25 image
classification: Exploratory fitting-pool transfer. Case 25 was selected with known official blood-label counts and annotation-run counts; NOT blind independent clinical validation.

source.dataset: Galar v2 corrected labels, Le Floch et al. (CC BY 4.0)

acquisition.policy: Retrieve one exact HTTP 206 source block, extract and validate only its allowed requested frames, then remove block compressed bytes before retrieving next block. No three-block simultaneous staging.
acquisition.source_checks: Verify official 7z header CRCs, known index-part SHA256s, full per-exam archive-member count per block and exact source-frame alignment before large transfer; reject missing or unexpected paths, roles, overlaps and bad PNG or ZIP integrity.
acquisition.storage: Only original images, labels, frame identities and checkpoint scores in private Library; no pixels or per-frame data in Git.

fixed_model_evaluation.reference_cohort: 512 locked label-blind uniform source-order images for Galar exam25; never use enriched-fit-only images for primary evaluation
fixed_model_evaluation.secondary_cohort: Full 1013 union only as explicitly enriched descriptive analysis
metrics: Within-examination ROC-AUC and average precision (very unstable with 14 positives)
Unchanged redness score and deterministic uniform positional sampling at same review budget

stop_rules: Any checkpoint mismatch, frozen input source mismatch, missing frame, incorrect reference count, unexpected source block, transport failure or integrity mismatch aborts and is disclosed. No favorable checkpoint/threshold search.
